purpose: Compact Grok / IDE project settings for Stardust on knarr. No credentials, keys, IPs, or secret paths. Full inventory: conf/stardust-knarr-settings.json once merged; artifacts copy until then.
paste_into_project_settings: Devuan sysvinit host starhq.knarr / knarr. Role devel. IDE Theia.
Repo github.com/landNull/Stardust.git. Default branch devel. Work branch features/GrokBranch. User merges GrokBranch into devel on starhq.
Stardust 0.4.0 is a CLI control plane for Backdrop CMS (Apache + PHP + MariaDB + Bee + crdir). Tools repo, not a site. Do not stardust platform-add stardust.
Read conf/project-settings.json and conf/stardust-knarr-settings.json before changing apps, roles, DNS, or vhosts.
install-stardust.sh installs platform apps from apps/MANIFEST only. It must not install product apps.
Platform install order: host apache dnsmasq php security mariadb deploy bee gitea.
Runtime (not an install phase): core platform site doctor migrate-d7 ui.
Product apps (Nextcloud first) are tenants under /srv/apps, not Backdrop sites under /srv/platforms. Do not stardust site-add nextcloud.
www-admin is group-only. Do not create a www-admin user. Extra login only with -a NAME when NAME != GROUP.
deploy is nologin, HOME /srv/stardust/home, locked. Groups www-admin,stardust,deploy. Never group sudo.
Sudoers: deploy + %www-admin for stardust-priv / bee / git / crdir only.
Name-based Apache *:80 + ServerName/ServerAlias. No loopback /etc/hosts pins for *.knarr or *.devel. No extra Listen 127.0.0.1:80.

repository.merge: User merges GrokBranch into devel on starhq

roles.www-admin: group only; owns code trees; sudo stardust-priv bee git crdir
roles.deploy: nologin system account; HOME /srv/stardust/home; never group sudo

contracts: Product apps: stardust apps install|align|status|remove|doctor NAME; code /srv/apps/<name>; data /srv/apps/<name>-data; secrets /srv/apps/<name>-secrets
install-stardust.sh does not install product apps
